column3: MT 140:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. The singular “an evil man … a man of violence” is rendered as plural, “evil men … violent men.”
Close to the Hebrew; “In the heart” is rendered “in their hearts,” and “every day” as “continually.”
Close to the Hebrew; The singular “a man of violence” is rendered “violent men,” and “my footsteps” as “my feet.”
Close to the Hebrew; The present “I say” is rendered “I said,” and NASB marks verses 6–11 as quoted speech.
“O Yahweh, O Lord” is printed “O GOD the Lord”; “you cover” is rendered “You have covered,” and “a day of weaponry” as “the day of battle.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB adds “evil” (“his evil device”), and “they will rise” is rendered “that they not be exalted.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB adds “deep” (“Into deep pits”).
“A man of tongue” is rendered “a slanderer,” and “for blows” as “speedily.”
Close to the Hebrew; “The poor” is rendered “the afflicted,” and “needy people” as “the poor.”
